title: Uniform law of matrix inputs
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, let $\kappa$ be a type with decidable equality, and let $I$ be a finite subset of $\kappa$. The probability mass function for the matrix of inputs indexed by $I$ and $\mathrm{Fin}(m)$ is the uniform probability mass function on all such matrices of $n$-dimensional sign vectors.
